answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging quill-like succinct argument systems to ensure verifiable uniqueness. By coupling comet-like unpredictable leader sortition with sequential delay functions, we establish an information-theoretic defense against identity spoofing. Under a zephyr of adaptive honest-majority assumptions, our construction proves computationally infeasible for adversaries to clone identities, yielding a robust reputation system.
